slug: 2026-06-17 Seacom deploys a new high-capacity Nairobi–Kampala route to strengthen East Africa's digital backbone

facts.fact: Seacom launched on 17 June 2026 a high-capacity terrestrial route Nairobi-Kisumu-Kampala carrying traffic inland from the subsea cable landing stations at Mombasa, crossing into Uganda at Malaba and Busia (both via Kenya), with 1Tbps activated.
Seacom says the Nairobi-Kampala route offers 1GE to 400GE interfaces to enterprises, service providers and hyperscale customers, i.e. capacity sold to buyers other than the owner.
